attempts.summary: Created dedicated system account inventorysvc on node1, deployed a systemd unit "inventory-worker" running /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker as that user, enabled and started it, then performed the mandatory single-node restart evidence protocol: captured baseline boot_id, rebooted node1, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified inventory-worker came back active/enabled and running under inventorysvc post-reboot.
